reference_standard_comment: unclear: the specific histology biopsy technique (e.g., scalpel/incisional/excisional biopsy) used to obtain the reference-standard diagnosis in this study is not explicitly described; the paper only states in background/discussion that 'the scalpel biopsy is still considered the gold standard' for early diagnostics, without confirming this was the technique used for these 2018 cases.
positive_threshold_oral_cancer_comment: infiltrative growth beyond the epithelial basement membrane
